title: Tool list
message: No tool change found, but 6 tool words were seen. This profile reads a tool change as a code of its own; a lathe program that changes tool with a bare T word needs a lathe profile.

findings.message: 6 tool words here, but no tool change: this dialect marks a tool change with a code of its own (M6 on the shipped Fanuc mill profile), and each of them was written without one. A turret lathe changes tool with a bare T word and needs a lathe profile, which gEdit does not ship yet.
